220  @BeforeAll
221  public static void setupBeforeClass() throws Exception {
222    // setup configuration
223    conf = TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration();
224    // Up the handlers; this test needs more than usual.
225    conf.setInt(HConstants.REGION_SERVER_HIGH_PRIORITY_HANDLER_COUNT, 10);
226
227    conf.set(CommonConfigurationKeys.HADOOP_SECURITY_GROUP_MAPPING,
228      MyShellBasedUnixGroupsMapping.class.getName());
229    UserGroupInformation.setConfiguration(conf);
230
231    // Enable security
232    enableSecurity(conf);
233    // In this particular test case, we can't use SecureBulkLoadEndpoint because its doAs will fail
234    // to move a file for a random user
235    conf.set(CoprocessorHost.REGION_COPROCESSOR_CONF_KEY, AccessController.class.getName());
236    // Verify enableSecurity sets up what we require
237    verifyConfiguration(conf);
238
239    // Enable EXEC permission checking
240    conf.setBoolean(AccessControlConstants.EXEC_PERMISSION_CHECKS_KEY, true);
241
242    TEST_UTIL.startMiniCluster();
243    MasterCoprocessorHost masterCpHost =
244      TEST_UTIL.getMiniHBaseCluster().getMaster().getMasterCoprocessorHost();
245    masterCpHost.load(AccessController.class, Coprocessor.PRIORITY_HIGHEST, conf);
246    ACCESS_CONTROLLER = masterCpHost.findCoprocessor(AccessController.class);
247    CP_ENV =
248      masterCpHost.createEnvironment(ACCESS_CONTROLLER, Coprocessor.PRIORITY_HIGHEST, 1, conf);
249    RegionServerCoprocessorHost rsCpHost =
250      TEST_UTIL.getMiniHBaseCluster().getRegionServer(0).getRegionServerCoprocessorHost();
251    RSCP_ENV = rsCpHost.createEnvironment(ACCESS_CONTROLLER, Coprocessor.PRIORITY_HIGHEST, 1, conf);
252
253    // Wait for the ACL table to become available
254    TEST_UTIL.waitUntilAllRegionsAssigned(PermissionStorage.ACL_TABLE_NAME);
255
256    // create a set of test users
257    SUPERUSER = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "admin", new String[] { "supergroup" });
258    USER_ADMIN = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "admin2", new String[0]);
259    USER_RW = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "rwuser", new String[0]);
260    USER_RO = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "rouser", new String[0]);
261    USER_OWNER = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "owner", new String[0]);
262    USER_CREATE = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "tbl_create", new String[0]);
263    USER_NONE = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "nouser", new String[0]);
264    USER_ADMIN_CF = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "col_family_admin", new String[0]);
265
266    USER_GROUP_ADMIN =
267      User.createUserForTesting(conf, "user_group_admin", new String[] { GROUP_ADMIN });
268    USER_GROUP_CREATE =
269      User.createUserForTesting(conf, "user_group_create", new String[] { GROUP_CREATE });
270    USER_GROUP_READ =
271      User.createUserForTesting(conf, "user_group_read", new String[] { GROUP_READ });
272    USER_GROUP_WRITE =
273      User.createUserForTesting(conf, "user_group_write", new String[] { GROUP_WRITE });
274
275    // Grant table creation permission to USER_OWNER
276    grantGlobal(TEST_UTIL, USER_OWNER.getShortName(), Action.CREATE);
277
278    systemUserConnection = TEST_UTIL.getConnection();
279    setUpTableAndUserPermissions();
280  }
281
282  @AfterAll

284    cleanUp();
285    TEST_UTIL.shutdownMiniCluster();
286  }

288  private static void setUpTableAndUserPermissions() throws Exception {
289    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor =
290      TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(TEST_TABLE)
291        .setColumnFamily(
292          ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(TEST_FAMILY).setMaxVersions(100).build())
293        .build();
294    createTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_OWNER, tableDescriptor, new byte[][] { Bytes.toBytes("s") });
295
296    HRegion region = TEST_UTIL.getHBaseCluster().getRegions(TEST_TABLE).get(0);
297    RegionCoprocessorHost rcpHost = region.getCoprocessorHost();
298    RCP_ENV = rcpHost.createEnvironment(ACCESS_CONTROLLER, Coprocessor.PRIORITY_HIGHEST, 1, conf);
299
300    // Set up initial grants
301
302    grantGlobal(TEST_UTIL, USER_ADMIN.getShortName(), Permission.Action.ADMIN,
303      Permission.Action.CREATE, Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE);
304
305    grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_RW.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE, TEST_FAMILY, null,
306      Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE);
307
308    // USER_CREATE is USER_RW plus CREATE permissions
309    grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_CREATE.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE, null, null,
310      Permission.Action.CREATE, Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE);
311
312    grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_RO.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE, TEST_FAMILY, null,
313      Permission.Action.READ);
314
315    grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_ADMIN_CF.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE, TEST_FAMILY, null,
316      Permission.Action.ADMIN, Permission.Action.CREATE);
317
318    grantGlobal(TEST_UTIL, toGroupEntry(GROUP_ADMIN), Permission.Action.ADMIN);
319    grantGlobal(TEST_UTIL, toGroupEntry(GROUP_CREATE), Permission.Action.CREATE);
320    grantGlobal(TEST_UTIL, toGroupEntry(GROUP_READ), Permission.Action.READ);
321    grantGlobal(TEST_UTIL, toGroupEntry(GROUP_WRITE), Permission.Action.WRITE);
322
323    assertEquals(5, PermissionStorage.getTablePermissions(conf, TEST_TABLE).size());
324    int size = 0;
325    try {
326      size =
327        AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(systemUserConnection, TEST_TABLE.toString()).size();
328    } catch (Throwable e) {
329      LOG.error("error during call of AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions. ", e);
330      fail("error during call of AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions.");
331    }
332    assertEquals(5, size);
333  }
334
335  private static void cleanUp() throws Exception {
336    // Clean the _acl_ table
337    try {
338      deleteTable(TEST_UTIL, TEST_TABLE);
339    } catch (TableNotFoundException ex) {
340      // Test deleted the table, no problem
341      LOG.info("Test deleted table " + TEST_TABLE);
342    }
343    // Verify all table/namespace permissions are erased
344    assertEquals(0, PermissionStorage.getTablePermissions(conf, TEST_TABLE).size());
345    assertEquals(0,
346      PermissionStorage.getNamespacePermissions(conf, TEST_TABLE.getNamespaceAsString()).size());
347  }

435  @Test
436  public void testTableCreate(TestInfo testInfo) throws Exception {
437    AccessTestAction createTable = new AccessTestAction() {
438      @Override
439      public Object run() throws Exception {
440        TableDescriptor tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder
441          .newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(testInfo.getTestMethod().get().getName()))
442          .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(TEST_FAMILY)).build();
443        ACCESS_CONTROLLER.preCreateTable(ObserverContextImpl.createAndPrepare(CP_ENV),
444          tableDescriptor, null);
445        return null;
446      }
447    };
448
449    // verify that superuser can create tables
450    verifyAllowed(createTable, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN, USER_GROUP_CREATE, USER_GROUP_ADMIN);
451
452    // all others should be denied
453    verifyDenied(createTable, USER_CREATE, USER_RW, USER_RO, USER_NONE, USER_GROUP_READ,
454      USER_GROUP_WRITE);
455  }

482  @Test
483  public void testTableModifyRemoveFamiliesClearsPermissions(TestInfo testInfo) throws Exception {
484    final TableName tableName = TableName.valueOf(testInfo.getTestMethod().get().getName());
485    final byte[] family1 = Bytes.toBytes("cf1");
486    final byte[] family2 = Bytes.toBytes("cf2");
487    final byte[] family3 = Bytes.toBytes("cf3");
488    // a qualifier on a surviving family, sharing its name with a dropped column family
489    final byte[] qualifier = Bytes.toBytes("cf1");
490
491    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName)
492      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family1))
493      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family2))
494      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family3)).build();
495    createTable(TEST_UTIL, tableDescriptor);
496
497    try {
498      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_NONE.getShortName(), tableName, null, null, Action.READ);
499      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_RO.getShortName(), tableName, family1, null, Action.READ);
500      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_RW.getShortName(), tableName, family1, TEST_QUALIFIER,
501        Action.READ);
502      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_CREATE.getShortName(), tableName, family2, null, Action.READ);
503      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_ADMIN_CF.getShortName(), tableName, family3, qualifier,
504        Action.READ);
505
506      ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms =
507        PermissionStorage.getTablePermissions(conf, tableName);
508      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_NONE, null, null, true);
509      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_RO, family1, null, true);
510      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_RW, family1, TEST_QUALIFIER, true);
511      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_CREATE, family2, null, true);
512      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_ADMIN_CF, family3, qualifier, true);
513
514      // Drop cf1 and cf2 in a single modify. The permissions scoped to them must be removed
515      // along with them, while the table level permission and the permissions on cf3 survive.
516      TableDescriptor droppedFamilyDesc = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName)
517        .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family3)).build();
518      try (Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin()) {
519        admin.modifyTable(droppedFamilyDesc);
520      }
521
522      perms = PermissionStorage.getTablePermissions(conf, tableName);
523      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_RO, family1, null, false);
524      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_RW, family1, TEST_QUALIFIER, false);
525      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_CREATE, family2, null, false);
526      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_NONE, null, null, true);
527      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_ADMIN_CF, family3, qualifier, true);
528
529      // Add cf1 and cf2 back. The removed permissions must not be resurrected.
530      TableDescriptor addedFamilyDesc = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName)
531        .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family1))
532        .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family2))
533        .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family3)).build();
534      try (Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin()) {
535        admin.modifyTable(addedFamilyDesc);
536      }
537
538      perms = PermissionStorage.getTablePermissions(conf, tableName);
539      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_RO, family1, null, false);
540      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_RW, family1, TEST_QUALIFIER, false);
541      assertTablePermission(perms, USER_CREATE, family2, null, false);
542
543      final AccessTestAction getFamily1Action = new AccessTestAction() {
544        @Override
545        public Object run() throws Exception {
546          Get get = new Get(TEST_ROW);
547          get.addColumn(family1, TEST_QUALIFIER);
548          try (Connection conn = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
549            Table table = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
550            table.get(get);
551          }
552          return null;
553        }
554      };
555      // wait until the cache update is propagated to all region servers
556      TEST_UTIL.waitFor(30000, 100, new Predicate<IOException>() {
557        @Override
558        public boolean evaluate() throws IOException {
559          try {
560            USER_RW.runAs(getFamily1Action);
561            return false;
562          } catch (AccessDeniedException e) {
563            return true;
564          } catch (InterruptedException e) {
565            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
566            return false;
567          }
568        }
569      });
570      verifyDenied(getFamily1Action, USER_RO, USER_RW);
571
572      final AccessTestAction getFamily2Action = new AccessTestAction() {
573        @Override
574        public Object run() throws Exception {
575          Get get = new Get(TEST_ROW);
576          get.addColumn(family2, TEST_QUALIFIER);
577          try (Connection conn = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
578            Table table = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
579            table.get(get);
580          }
581          return null;
582        }
583      };
584      verifyDenied(getFamily2Action, USER_CREATE);
585
586      final AccessTestAction getFamily3Action = new AccessTestAction() {
587        @Override
588        public Object run() throws Exception {
589          Get get = new Get(TEST_ROW);
590          get.addColumn(family3, qualifier);
591          try (Connection conn = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
592            Table table = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
593            table.get(get);
594          }
595          return null;
596        }
597      };
598      verifyAllowed(getFamily3Action, USER_ADMIN_CF);
599    } finally {
600      deleteTable(TEST_UTIL, tableName);
601    }
602  }

604  private static void assertTablePermission(ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms, User user,
605    byte[] family, byte[] qualifier, boolean expected) {
606    boolean found = false;
607    for (UserPermission perm : perms.get(user.getShortName())) {
608      if (perm.getPermission() instanceof TablePermission) {
609        TablePermission tablePermission = (TablePermission) perm.getPermission();
610        if (
611          Arrays.equals(family, tablePermission.getFamily())
612            && Arrays.equals(qualifier, tablePermission.getQualifier())
613        ) {
614          found = true;
615          break;
616        }
617      }
618    }
619    assertEquals(expected, found,
620      "Unexpected permission state for " + user.getShortName() + " on family="
621        + (family == null ? "<table level>" : Bytes.toStringBinary(family)) + ", qualifier="
622        + (qualifier == null ? "<family level>" : Bytes.toStringBinary(qualifier)));
623  }

699  public static class TestTableDDLProcedure extends Procedure<MasterProcedureEnv>
700    implements TableProcedureInterface {
701    private TableName tableName;
702
703    public TestTableDDLProcedure() {
704    }
705
706    public TestTableDDLProcedure(final MasterProcedureEnv env, final TableName tableName)
707      throws IOException {
708      this.tableName = tableName;
709      this.setTimeout(180000); // Timeout in 3 minutes
710      this.setOwner(env.getRequestUser());
711    }
712
713    @Override
714    public TableName getTableName() {
715      return tableName;
716    }
717
718    @Override
719    public TableOperationType getTableOperationType() {
720      return TableOperationType.EDIT;
721    }
722
723    @Override
724    protected boolean abort(MasterProcedureEnv env) {
725      return true;
726    }
727
728    @Override
729    protected void serializeStateData(ProcedureStateSerializer serializer) throws IOException {
730      TestProcedureProtos.TestTableDDLStateData.Builder testTableDDLMsg =
731        TestProcedureProtos.TestTableDDLStateData.newBuilder()
732          .setTableName(tableName.getNameAsString());
733      serializer.serialize(testTableDDLMsg.build());
734    }
735
736    @Override
737    protected void deserializeStateData(ProcedureStateSerializer serializer) throws IOException {
738      TestProcedureProtos.TestTableDDLStateData testTableDDLMsg =
739        serializer.deserialize(TestProcedureProtos.TestTableDDLStateData.class);
740      tableName = TableName.valueOf(testTableDDLMsg.getTableName());
741    }
742
743    @Override
744    protected Procedure[] execute(MasterProcedureEnv env)
745      throws ProcedureYieldException, InterruptedException {
746      // Not letting the procedure to complete until timed out
747      setState(ProcedureState.WAITING_TIMEOUT);
748      return null;
749    }
750
751    @Override
752    protected void rollback(MasterProcedureEnv env) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
753    }
754  }

1247  public static class BulkLoadHelper {
1248    private final FileSystem fs;
1249    private final Path loadPath;
1250    private final Configuration conf;
1251
1252    public BulkLoadHelper(Path loadPath) throws IOException {
1253      fs = TEST_UTIL.getTestFileSystem();
1254      conf = TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration();
1255      loadPath = loadPath.makeQualified(fs);
1256      this.loadPath = loadPath;
1257    }
1258
1259    private void createHFile(Path path, byte[] family, byte[] qualifier, byte[] startKey,
1260      byte[] endKey, int numRows) throws IOException {
1261      HFile.Writer writer = null;
1262      long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
1263      try {
1264        HFileContext context = new HFileContextBuilder().build();
1265        writer = HFile.getWriterFactory(conf, new CacheConfig(conf)).withPath(fs, path)
1266          .withFileContext(context).create();
1267        // subtract 2 since numRows doesn't include boundary keys
1268        for (byte[] key : Bytes.iterateOnSplits(startKey, endKey, true, numRows - 2)) {
1269          KeyValue kv = new KeyValue(key, family, qualifier, now, key);
1270          writer.append(kv);
1271        }
1272      } finally {
1273        if (writer != null) {
1274          writer.close();
1275        }
1276      }
1277    }
1278
1279    private BulkLoadHelper initHFileData(byte[] family, byte[] qualifier, byte[][][] hfileRanges,
1280      int numRowsPerRange, FsPermission filePermission) throws Exception {
1281      Path familyDir = new Path(loadPath, Bytes.toString(family));
1282      fs.mkdirs(familyDir);
1283      int hfileIdx = 0;
1284      List<Path> hfiles = new ArrayList<>();
1285      for (byte[][] range : hfileRanges) {
1286        byte[] from = range[0];
1287        byte[] to = range[1];
1288        Path hfile = new Path(familyDir, "hfile_" + (hfileIdx++));
1289        hfiles.add(hfile);
1290        createHFile(hfile, family, qualifier, from, to, numRowsPerRange);
1291      }
1292      // set global read so RegionServer can move it
1293      setPermission(fs, loadPath, FS_PERMISSION_ALL);
1294      // Ensure the file permission as requested.
1295      for (Path hfile : hfiles) {
1296        setPermission(fs, hfile, filePermission);
1297      }
1298      return this;
1299    }
1300
1301    private void bulkLoadHFile(TableName tableName) throws Exception {
1302      TEST_UTIL.waitUntilAllRegionsAssigned(tableName);
1303      BulkLoadHFiles.create(conf).bulkLoad(tableName, loadPath);
1304    }
1305
1306    private static void setPermission(FileSystem fs, Path dir, FsPermission perm)
1307      throws IOException {
1308      if (!fs.getFileStatus(dir).isDirectory()) {
1309        fs.setPermission(dir, perm);
1310      } else {
1311        for (FileStatus el : fs.listStatus(dir)) {
1312          fs.setPermission(el.getPath(), perm);
1313          setPermission(fs, el.getPath(), perm);
1314        }
1315      }
1316    }
1317  }

1672      verifyDenied(gblUser, putActionAll, putAction1, putAction2);
1673      verifyDenied(gblUser, deleteActionAll, deleteAction1, deleteAction2);

1677      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, tblUser.getShortName(), tableName, family1, null,
1678        Permission.Action.READ);

1682      verifyDenied(tblUser, getAction2);
1683      verifyDenied(tblUser, putActionAll, putAction1, putAction2);
1684      verifyDenied(tblUser, deleteActionAll, deleteAction1, deleteAction2);
1685
1686      verifyAllowed(gblUser, getActionAll, getAction1, getAction2);
1687      verifyDenied(gblUser, putActionAll, putAction1, putAction2);
1688      verifyDenied(gblUser, deleteActionAll, deleteAction1, deleteAction2);

1692      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, tblUser.getShortName(), tableName, family2, null,
1693        Permission.Action.WRITE);
1694
1695      // READ from family1, WRITE to family2 are allowed
1696      verifyAllowed(tblUser, getActionAll, getAction1);
1697      verifyAllowed(tblUser, putAction2, deleteAction2);
1698      verifyDenied(tblUser, getAction2);
1699      verifyDenied(tblUser, putActionAll, putAction1);
1700      verifyDenied(tblUser, deleteActionAll, deleteAction1);
1701
1702      verifyDenied(gblUser, getActionAll, getAction1, getAction2);
1703      verifyAllowed(gblUser, putActionAll, putAction1, putAction2);
1704      verifyAllowed(gblUser, deleteActionAll, deleteAction1, deleteAction2);
1705
1706      // revoke column family permission
1707      revokeGlobal(TEST_UTIL, gblUser.getShortName());
1708      revokeFromTable(TEST_UTIL, tblUser.getShortName(), tableName, family2, null);
1709
1710      // Revoke on family2 should not have impact on family1 permissions
1711      verifyAllowed(tblUser, getActionAll, getAction1);
1712      verifyDenied(tblUser, getAction2);
1713      verifyDenied(tblUser, putActionAll, putAction1, putAction2);
1714      verifyDenied(tblUser, deleteActionAll, deleteAction1, deleteAction2);
1715
1716      // Should not have access as global permissions are completely revoked
1717      verifyDenied(gblUser, getActionAll, getAction1, getAction2);
1718      verifyDenied(gblUser, putActionAll, putAction1, putAction2);
1719      verifyDenied(gblUser, deleteActionAll, deleteAction1, deleteAction2);
1720    } finally {
1721      // delete table
1722      deleteTable(TEST_UTIL, tableName);
1723    }
1724  }

1739    final byte[] family1 = Bytes.toBytes("f1");
1740    final byte[] family2 = Bytes.toBytes("f2");

1742
1743    // create table
1744    Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin();

1746      deleteTable(TEST_UTIL, tableName);
1747    }
1748    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName)
1749      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family1))
1750      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family2)).build();
1751    createTable(TEST_UTIL, tableDescriptor);
1752
1753    try {
1754      // create temp users
1755      User user = User.createUserForTesting(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(), "user", new String[0]);
1756
1757      AccessTestAction getQualifierAction = new AccessTestAction() {
1758        @Override
1759        public Object run() throws Exception {
1760          Get g = new Get(TEST_ROW);
1761          g.addColumn(family1, qualifier);
1762          try (Connection conn = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
1763            Table t = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
1764            t.get(g);
1765          }
1766          return null;
1767        }
1768      };
1769
1770      AccessTestAction putQualifierAction = new AccessTestAction() {
1771        @Override
1772        public Object run() throws Exception {
1773          Put p = new Put(TEST_ROW);
1774          p.addColumn(family1, qualifier, Bytes.toBytes("v1"));
1775          try (Connection conn = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
1776            Table t = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
1777            t.put(p);
1778          }
1779          return null;
1780        }
1781      };
1782
1783      AccessTestAction deleteQualifierAction = new AccessTestAction() {
1784        @Override
1785        public Object run() throws Exception {
1786          Delete d = new Delete(TEST_ROW);
1787          d.addColumn(family1, qualifier);
1788          // d.deleteFamily(family1);
1789          try (Connection conn = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
1790            Table t = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
1791            t.delete(d);
1792          }
1793          return null;
1794        }
1795      };
1796
1797      revokeFromTable(TEST_UTIL, user.getShortName(), tableName, family1, null);
1798
1799      verifyDenied(user, getQualifierAction);
1800      verifyDenied(user, putQualifierAction);
1801      verifyDenied(user, deleteQualifierAction);
1802
1803      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, user.getShortName(), tableName, family1, qualifier,
1804        Permission.Action.READ);
1805
1806      verifyAllowed(user, getQualifierAction);
1807      verifyDenied(user, putQualifierAction);
1808      verifyDenied(user, deleteQualifierAction);
1809
1810      // only grant write permission
1811      // TODO: comment this portion after HBASE-3583
1812      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, user.getShortName(), tableName, family1, qualifier,
1813        Permission.Action.WRITE);
1814
1815      verifyDenied(user, getQualifierAction);
1816      verifyAllowed(user, putQualifierAction);
1817      verifyAllowed(user, deleteQualifierAction);
1818
1819      // grant both read and write permission
1820      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, user.getShortName(), tableName, family1, qualifier,
1821        Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE);
1822
1823      verifyAllowed(user, getQualifierAction);
1824      verifyAllowed(user, putQualifierAction);
1825      verifyAllowed(user, deleteQualifierAction);
1826
1827      // revoke family level permission won't impact column level
1828      revokeFromTable(TEST_UTIL, user.getShortName(), tableName, family1, qualifier);
1829
1830      verifyDenied(user, getQualifierAction);
1831      verifyDenied(user, putQualifierAction);
1832      verifyDenied(user, deleteQualifierAction);
1833    } finally {
1834      // delete table
1835      deleteTable(TEST_UTIL, tableName);
1836    }
1837  }

1839  @Test
1840  public void testPermissionList(TestInfo testInfo) throws Exception {
1841    final TableName tableName = TableName.valueOf(testInfo.getTestMethod().get().getName());
1842    final byte[] family1 = Bytes.toBytes("f1");
1843    final byte[] family2 = Bytes.toBytes("f2");
1844    final byte[] qualifier = Bytes.toBytes("q");
1845
1846    // create table
1847    Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin();
1848    if (admin.tableExists(tableName)) {
1849      deleteTable(TEST_UTIL, tableName);
1850    }
1851    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName)
1852      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family1))
1853      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family2)).build();
1854    createTable(TEST_UTIL, USER_OWNER, tableDescriptor);
1855    try {
1856      List<UserPermission> perms =
1857        admin.getUserPermissions(GetUserPermissionsRequest.newBuilder(tableName).build());
1858      UserPermission ownerperm = new UserPermission(USER_OWNER.getName(),
1859        Permission.newBuilder(tableName).withActions(Action.values()).build());
1860      assertTrue(hasFoundUserPermission(ownerperm, perms),
1861        "Owner should have all permissions on table");
1862
1863      User user = User.createUserForTesting(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(), "user", new String[0]);
1864      String userName = user.getShortName();
1865
1866      UserPermission up = new UserPermission(userName, Permission.newBuilder(tableName)
1867        .withFamily(family1).withQualifier(qualifier).withActions(Permission.Action.READ).build());
1868      assertFalse(hasFoundUserPermission(up, perms),
1869        "User should not be granted permission: " + up.toString());
1870
1871      // grant read permission
1872      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, user.getShortName(), tableName, family1, qualifier,
1873        Permission.Action.READ);
1874
1875      perms = admin.getUserPermissions(GetUserPermissionsRequest.newBuilder(tableName).build());
1876      UserPermission upToVerify = new UserPermission(userName, Permission.newBuilder(tableName)
1877        .withFamily(family1).withQualifier(qualifier).withActions(Permission.Action.READ).build());
1878      assertTrue(hasFoundUserPermission(upToVerify, perms),
1879        "User should be granted permission: " + upToVerify.toString());
1880
1881      upToVerify = new UserPermission(userName, Permission.newBuilder(tableName).withFamily(family1)
1882        .withQualifier(qualifier).withActions(Permission.Action.WRITE).build());
1883      assertFalse(hasFoundUserPermission(upToVerify, perms),
1884        "User should not be granted permission: " + upToVerify.toString());
1885
1886      // grant read+write
1887      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, user.getShortName(), tableName, family1, qualifier,
1888        Permission.Action.WRITE, Permission.Action.READ);
1889
1890      perms = admin.getUserPermissions(GetUserPermissionsRequest.newBuilder(tableName).build());
1891      upToVerify = new UserPermission(userName,
1892        Permission.newBuilder(tableName).withFamily(family1).withQualifier(qualifier)
1893          .withActions(Permission.Action.WRITE, Permission.Action.READ).build());
1894      assertTrue(hasFoundUserPermission(upToVerify, perms),
1895        "User should be granted permission: " + upToVerify.toString());
1896
1897      // revoke
1898      revokeFromTable(TEST_UTIL, user.getShortName(), tableName, family1, qualifier,
1899        Permission.Action.WRITE, Permission.Action.READ);
1900
1901      perms = admin.getUserPermissions(GetUserPermissionsRequest.newBuilder(tableName).build());
1902      assertFalse(hasFoundUserPermission(upToVerify, perms),
1903        "User should not be granted permission: " + upToVerify.toString());
1904
1905      User newOwner = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "new_owner", new String[] {});
1906      grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, newOwner.getShortName(), tableName, null, null,
1907        Permission.Action.values());
1908
1909      perms = admin.getUserPermissions(GetUserPermissionsRequest.newBuilder(tableName).build());
1910      UserPermission newOwnerperm = new UserPermission(newOwner.getName(),
1911        Permission.newBuilder(tableName).withActions(Action.values()).build());
1912      assertTrue(hasFoundUserPermission(newOwnerperm, perms),
1913        "New owner should have all permissions on table");
1914    } finally {
1915      // delete table
1916      deleteTable(TEST_UTIL, tableName);
1917    }
1918  }

1920  @Test

1925    Collection<String> superUsers = Superusers.getSuperUsers();

2008          checkTablePerms(TEST_UTIL, TEST_TABLE, TEST_FAMILY, TEST_Q1, Permission.Action.READ);
2009          return null;

2013      AccessTestAction multiQualifierRead = new AccessTestAction() {

2015        public Void run() throws Exception {
2016          checkTablePerms(TEST_UTIL,
2017            new Permission[] {
2018              Permission.newBuilder(TEST_TABLE).withFamily(TEST_FAMILY).withQualifier(TEST_Q1)
2019                .withActions(Permission.Action.READ).build(),
2020              Permission.newBuilder(TEST_TABLE).withFamily(TEST_FAMILY).withQualifier(TEST_Q2)
2021                .withActions(Permission.Action.READ).build(), });
2022          return null;
2023        }
2024      };
2025
2026      AccessTestAction globalAndTableRead = new AccessTestAction() {
2027        @Override
2028        public Void run() throws Exception {
2029          checkTablePerms(TEST_UTIL, new Permission[] { new Permission(Permission.Action.READ),
2030            Permission.newBuilder(TEST_TABLE).withActions(Permission.Action.READ).build() });
2031          return null;
2032        }
2033      };
2034
2035      AccessTestAction noCheck = new AccessTestAction() {
2036        @Override
2037        public Void run() throws Exception {
2038          checkTablePerms(TEST_UTIL, new Permission[0]);
2039          return null;
2040        }
2041      };
2042
2043      verifyAllowed(tableRead, SUPERUSER, userTable);
2044      verifyDenied(tableRead, userColumn, userQualifier);
2045
2046      verifyAllowed(columnRead, SUPERUSER, userTable, userColumn);
2047      verifyDenied(columnRead, userQualifier);
2048
2049      verifyAllowed(qualifierRead, SUPERUSER, userTable, userColumn, userQualifier);
2050
2051      verifyAllowed(multiQualifierRead, SUPERUSER, userTable, userColumn);
2052      verifyDenied(multiQualifierRead, userQualifier);
2053
2054      verifyAllowed(globalAndTableRead, SUPERUSER);
2055      verifyDenied(globalAndTableRead, userTable, userColumn, userQualifier);
2056
2057      verifyAllowed(noCheck, SUPERUSER, userTable, userColumn, userQualifier);
2058
2059      // --------------------------------------
2060      // test family level multiple permissions
2061      AccessTestAction familyReadWrite = new AccessTestAction() {
2062        @Override
2063        public Void run() throws Exception {
2064          checkTablePerms(TEST_UTIL, TEST_TABLE, TEST_FAMILY, null, Permission.Action.READ,
2065            Permission.Action.WRITE);
2066          return null;
2067        }
2068      };
2069
2070      verifyAllowed(familyReadWrite, SUPERUSER, USER_OWNER, USER_CREATE, USER_RW);
2071      verifyDenied(familyReadWrite, USER_NONE, USER_RO);
2072
2073      // --------------------------------------
2074      // check for wrong table region
2075      CheckPermissionsRequest checkRequest = CheckPermissionsRequest.newBuilder()
2076        .addPermission(AccessControlProtos.Permission.newBuilder()
2077          .setType(AccessControlProtos.Permission.Type.Table)
2078          .setTablePermission(AccessControlProtos.TablePermission.newBuilder()
2079            .setTableName(ProtobufUtil.toProtoTableName(TEST_TABLE))
2080            .addAction(AccessControlProtos.Permission.Action.CREATE)))
2081        .build();
2082      Table acl = systemUserConnection.getTable(PermissionStorage.ACL_TABLE_NAME);
2083      try {
2084        BlockingRpcChannel channel = acl.coprocessorService(new byte[0]);
2085        AccessControlService.BlockingInterface protocol =
2086          AccessControlService.newBlockingStub(channel);
2087        try {
2088          // but ask for TablePermissions for TEST_TABLE
2089          protocol.checkPermissions(null, checkRequest);
2090          fail("this should have thrown CoprocessorException");
2091        } catch (ServiceException ex) {
2092          // expected
2093        }
2094      } finally {
2095        acl.close();
2096      }
2097
2098    } finally {
2099      revokeFromTable(TEST_UTIL, userTable.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE, null, null,
2100        Permission.Action.READ);
2101      revokeFromTable(TEST_UTIL, userColumn.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE, TEST_FAMILY, null,

2103      revokeFromTable(TEST_UTIL, userQualifier.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE, TEST_FAMILY, TEST_Q1,
2104        Permission.Action.READ);
2105    }
2106  }

2326  @Test
2327  public void testGlobalAuthorizationForNewRegisteredRS() throws Exception {
2328    LOG.debug("Test for global authorization for a new registered RegionServer.");
2329    SingleProcessHBaseCluster hbaseCluster = TEST_UTIL.getHBaseCluster();
2330
2331    final Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin();
2332    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(TEST_TABLE2)
2333      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(TEST_FAMILY)).build();
2334    createTable(TEST_UTIL, tableDescriptor);
2335
2336    // Starting a new RegionServer.
2337    JVMClusterUtil.RegionServerThread newRsThread = hbaseCluster.startRegionServer();
2338    final HRegionServer newRs = newRsThread.getRegionServer();
2339
2340    // Move region to the new RegionServer.
2341    List<HRegionLocation> regions;
2342    try (RegionLocator locator = systemUserConnection.getRegionLocator(TEST_TABLE2)) {
2343      regions = locator.getAllRegionLocations();
2344    }
2345    HRegionLocation location = regions.get(0);
2346    final RegionInfo hri = location.getRegion();
2347    final ServerName server = location.getServerName();
2348    try (Table table = systemUserConnection.getTable(TEST_TABLE2)) {
2349      AccessTestAction moveAction = new AccessTestAction() {
2350        @Override
2351        public Object run() throws Exception {
2352          admin.move(hri.getEncodedNameAsBytes(), newRs.getServerName());
2353          return null;
2354        }
2355      };
2356      SUPERUSER.runAs(moveAction);
2357
2358      final int RETRIES_LIMIT = 10;
2359      int retries = 0;
2360      while (newRs.getRegions(TEST_TABLE2).size() < 1 && retries < RETRIES_LIMIT) {
2361        LOG.debug("Waiting for region to be opened. Already retried " + retries + " times.");
2362        try {
2363          Thread.sleep(1000);
2364        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
2365        }
2366        retries++;
2367        if (retries == RETRIES_LIMIT - 1) {
2368          fail("Retry exhaust for waiting region to be opened.");
2369        }
2370      }
2371      // Verify write permission for user "admin2" who has the global
2372      // permissions.
2373      AccessTestAction putAction = new AccessTestAction() {
2374        @Override
2375        public Object run() throws Exception {
2376          Put put = new Put(Bytes.toBytes("test"));
2377          put.addColumn(TEST_FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("qual"), Bytes.toBytes("value"));
2378          table.put(put);
2379          return null;
2380        }
2381      };
2382      USER_ADMIN.runAs(putAction);
2383    }
2384  }

2815  @Test
2816  public void testCoprocessorExec() throws Exception {
2817    // Set up our ping endpoint service on all regions of our test table
2818    for (JVMClusterUtil.RegionServerThread thread : TEST_UTIL.getMiniHBaseCluster()
2819      .getRegionServerThreads()) {
2820      HRegionServer rs = thread.getRegionServer();
2821      for (HRegion region : rs.getRegions(TEST_TABLE)) {
2822        region.getCoprocessorHost().load(PingCoprocessor.class, Coprocessor.PRIORITY_USER, conf);
2823      }
2824    }
2825
2826    // Create users for testing, and grant EXEC privileges on our test table
2827    // only to user A
2828    User userA = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "UserA", new String[0]);
2829    User userB = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "UserB", new String[0]);
2830
2831    grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, userA.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE, null, null, Permission.Action.EXEC);
2832    try {
2833      // Create an action for invoking our test endpoint
2834      AccessTestAction execEndpointAction = new AccessTestAction() {
2835        @Override
2836        public Object run() throws Exception {
2837          try (Connection conn = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
2838            Table t = conn.getTable(TEST_TABLE)) {
2839            BlockingRpcChannel service = t.coprocessorService(HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY);
2840            PingCoprocessor.newBlockingStub(service).noop(null, NoopRequest.newBuilder().build());
2841          }
2842          return null;
2843        }
2844      };
2845
2846      String namespace = TEST_TABLE.getNamespaceAsString();
2847      // Now grant EXEC to the entire namespace to user B
2848      grantOnNamespace(TEST_UTIL, userB.getShortName(), namespace, Permission.Action.EXEC);
2849      // User B should now be allowed also
2850      verifyAllowed(execEndpointAction, userA, userB);
2851
2852      revokeFromNamespace(TEST_UTIL, userB.getShortName(), namespace, Permission.Action.EXEC);
2853      // Verify that EXEC permission is checked correctly
2854      verifyDenied(execEndpointAction, userB);
2855      verifyAllowed(execEndpointAction, userA);
2856    } finally {
2857      // Cleanup, revoke the userA privileges
2858      revokeFromTable(TEST_UTIL, userA.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE, null, null,
2859        Permission.Action.EXEC);
2860    }
2861  }

2961  /**
2962   * List all user permissions match the given regular expression for namespace and verify each of
2963   * them.
2964   * @param namespaceRegexWithoutPrefix the regualar expression for namespace, without
2965   *                                    NAMESPACE_PREFIX
2966   * @param expectedAmount              the expected amount of user permissions returned
2967   * @param expectedNamespace           the expected namespace of each user permission returned
2968   * @throws HBaseException in the case of any HBase exception when accessing hbase:acl table
2969   */
2970  private void getNamespacePermissionsAndVerify(String namespaceRegexWithoutPrefix,
2971    int expectedAmount, String expectedNamespace) throws HBaseException {
2972    try {
2973      List<UserPermission> namespacePermissions = AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(
2974        systemUserConnection, PermissionStorage.toNamespaceEntry(namespaceRegexWithoutPrefix));
2975      assertTrue(namespacePermissions != null);
2976      assertEquals(expectedAmount, namespacePermissions.size());
2977      for (UserPermission namespacePermission : namespacePermissions) {
2978        // Verify it is not a global user permission
2979        assertFalse(namespacePermission.getAccessScope() == Permission.Scope.GLOBAL);
2980        // Verify namespace is set
2981        NamespacePermission nsPerm = (NamespacePermission) namespacePermission.getPermission();
2982        assertEquals(expectedNamespace, nsPerm.getNamespace());
2983      }
2984    } catch (Throwable thw) {
2985      throw new HBaseException(thw);
2986    }
2987  }

3041  @Test
3042  public void testAccessControllerUserPermsRegexHandling(TestInfo testInfo) throws Exception {
3043    User testRegexHandler = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "testRegexHandling", new String[0]);
3044
3045    final String REGEX_ALL_TABLES = ".*";
3046    final String tableName = testInfo.getTestMethod().get().getName();
3047    final TableName table1 = TableName.valueOf(tableName);
3048    final byte[] family = Bytes.toBytes("f1");
3049
3050    // create table in default ns
3051    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(table1)
3052      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family)).build();
3053    createTable(TEST_UTIL, tableDescriptor);
3054
3055    // creating the ns and table in it
3056    String ns = "testNamespace";
3057    NamespaceDescriptor desc = NamespaceDescriptor.create(ns).build();
3058    final TableName table2 = TableName.valueOf(ns, tableName);
3059    createNamespace(TEST_UTIL, desc);
3060    tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(table2)
3061      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(family)).build();
3062    createTable(TEST_UTIL, tableDescriptor);
3063
3064    // Verify that we can read sys-tables
3065    String aclTableName = PermissionStorage.ACL_TABLE_NAME.getNameAsString();
3066    assertEquals(6, SUPERUSER.runAs(getPrivilegedAction(aclTableName)).size());
3067    assertEquals(0, testRegexHandler.runAs(getPrivilegedAction(aclTableName)).size());
3068
3069    // Grant TABLE ADMIN privs to testUserPerms
3070    assertEquals(0, testRegexHandler.runAs(getPrivilegedAction(REGEX_ALL_TABLES)).size());
3071    grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, testRegexHandler.getShortName(), table1, null, null, Action.ADMIN);
3072    assertEquals(2, testRegexHandler.runAs(getPrivilegedAction(REGEX_ALL_TABLES)).size());
3073    grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, testRegexHandler.getShortName(), table2, null, null, Action.ADMIN);
3074    assertEquals(4, testRegexHandler.runAs(getPrivilegedAction(REGEX_ALL_TABLES)).size());
3075
3076    // USER_ADMIN, testUserPerms must have a row each.
3077    assertEquals(2, testRegexHandler.runAs(getPrivilegedAction(tableName)).size());
3078    assertEquals(2,
3079      testRegexHandler
3080        .runAs(getPrivilegedAction(
3081          NamespaceDescriptor.DEFAULT_NAMESPACE_NAME_STR + TableName.NAMESPACE_DELIM + tableName))
3082        .size());
3083    assertEquals(2, testRegexHandler
3084      .runAs(getPrivilegedAction(ns + TableName.NAMESPACE_DELIM + tableName)).size());
3085    assertEquals(0, testRegexHandler.runAs(getPrivilegedAction("notMatchingAny")).size());
3086
3087    deleteTable(TEST_UTIL, table1);
3088    deleteTable(TEST_UTIL, table2);
3089    deleteNamespace(TEST_UTIL, ns);
3090  }

3290  @Test
3291  public void testRemoteLocks(TestInfo testInfo) throws Exception {
3292    String namespace = "preQueueNs";
3293    final TableName tableName =
3294      TableName.valueOf(namespace, testInfo.getTestMethod().get().getName());
3295    RegionInfo[] regionInfos = new RegionInfo[] { RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(tableName).build() };
3296
3297    // Setup Users
3298    // User will be granted ADMIN and CREATE on namespace. Should be denied before grant.
3299    User namespaceUser = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "qLNSUser", new String[0]);
3300    // User will be granted ADMIN and CREATE on table. Should be denied before grant.
3301    User tableACUser = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "qLTableACUser", new String[0]);
3302    // User will be granted READ, WRITE, EXECUTE on table. Should be denied.
3303    User tableRWXUser = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "qLTableRWXUser", new String[0]);
3304    grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, tableRWXUser.getShortName(), tableName, null, null, Action.READ,
3305      Action.WRITE, Action.EXEC);
3306    // User with global READ, WRITE, EXECUTE should be denied lock access.
3307    User globalRWXUser = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "qLGlobalRWXUser", new String[0]);
3308    grantGlobal(TEST_UTIL, globalRWXUser.getShortName(), Action.READ, Action.WRITE, Action.EXEC);
3309
3310    AccessTestAction namespaceLockAction = new AccessTestAction() {
3311      @Override
3312      public Object run() throws Exception {
3313        ACCESS_CONTROLLER.preRequestLock(ObserverContextImpl.createAndPrepare(CP_ENV), namespace,
3314          null, null, null);
3315        return null;
3316      }
3317    };
3318    verifyAllowed(namespaceLockAction, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN);
3319    verifyDenied(namespaceLockAction, globalRWXUser, tableACUser, namespaceUser, tableRWXUser);
3320    grantOnNamespace(TEST_UTIL, namespaceUser.getShortName(), namespace, Action.ADMIN);
3321    // Why I need this pause? I don't need it elsewhere.
3322    Threads.sleep(1000);
3323    verifyAllowed(namespaceLockAction, namespaceUser);
3324
3325    AccessTestAction tableLockAction = new AccessTestAction() {
3326      @Override
3327      public Object run() throws Exception {
3328        ACCESS_CONTROLLER.preRequestLock(ObserverContextImpl.createAndPrepare(CP_ENV), null,
3329          tableName, null, null);
3330        return null;
3331      }
3332    };
3333    verifyAllowed(tableLockAction, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN, namespaceUser);
3334    verifyDenied(tableLockAction, globalRWXUser, tableACUser, tableRWXUser);
3335    grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, tableACUser.getShortName(), tableName, null, null, Action.ADMIN,
3336      Action.CREATE);
3337    // See if this can fail (flakie) because grant hasn't propagated yet.
3338    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
3339      try {
3340        verifyAllowed(tableLockAction, tableACUser);
3341      } catch (AssertionError e) {
3342        LOG.warn("Retrying assertion error", e);
3343        Threads.sleep(1000);
3344        continue;
3345      }
3346    }
3347
3348    AccessTestAction regionsLockAction = new AccessTestAction() {
3349      @Override
3350      public Object run() throws Exception {
3351        ACCESS_CONTROLLER.preRequestLock(ObserverContextImpl.createAndPrepare(CP_ENV), null, null,
3352          regionInfos, null);
3353        return null;
3354      }
3355    };
3356    verifyAllowed(regionsLockAction, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN, namespaceUser, tableACUser);
3357    verifyDenied(regionsLockAction, globalRWXUser, tableRWXUser);
3358
3359    // Test heartbeats
3360    // Create a lock procedure and try sending heartbeat to it. It doesn't matter how the lock
3361    // was created, we just need namespace from the lock's tablename.
3362    LockProcedure proc = new LockProcedure(conf, tableName, LockType.EXCLUSIVE, "test", null);
3363    AccessTestAction regionLockHeartbeatAction = new AccessTestAction() {
3364      @Override
3365      public Object run() throws Exception {
3366        ACCESS_CONTROLLER.preLockHeartbeat(ObserverContextImpl.createAndPrepare(CP_ENV),
3367          proc.getTableName(), proc.getDescription());
3368        return null;
3369      }
3370    };
3371    verifyAllowed(regionLockHeartbeatAction, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN, namespaceUser, tableACUser);
3372    verifyDenied(regionLockHeartbeatAction, globalRWXUser, tableRWXUser);
3373  }

3375  @Test
3376  public void testAccessControlRevokeOnlyFewPermission() throws Throwable {
3377    TableName tname = TableName.valueOf("revoke");
3378    try {
3379      TEST_UTIL.createTable(tname, TEST_FAMILY);
3380      User testUserPerms = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "revokePerms", new String[0]);
3381      Permission.Action[] actions = { Action.READ, Action.WRITE };
3382      AccessControlClient.grant(TEST_UTIL.getConnection(), tname, testUserPerms.getShortName(),
3383        null, null, actions);
3384
3385      List<UserPermission> userPermissions =
3386        AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(TEST_UTIL.getConnection(), tname.getNameAsString());
3387      assertEquals(2, userPermissions.size());
3388
3389      AccessControlClient.revoke(TEST_UTIL.getConnection(), tname, testUserPerms.getShortName(),
3390        null, null, Action.WRITE);
3391
3392      userPermissions =
3393        AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(TEST_UTIL.getConnection(), tname.getNameAsString());
3394      assertEquals(2, userPermissions.size());
3395
3396      Permission.Action[] expectedAction = { Action.READ };
3397      boolean userFound = false;
3398      for (UserPermission p : userPermissions) {
3399        if (testUserPerms.getShortName().equals(p.getUser())) {
3400          assertArrayEquals(expectedAction, p.getPermission().getActions());
3401          userFound = true;
3402          break;
3403        }
3404      }
3405      assertTrue(userFound);
3406    } finally {
3407      TEST_UTIL.deleteTable(tname);
3408    }
3409  }

3567  @Test
3568  public void testGetUserPermissionsScopeBasedAuthorization() throws Throwable {
3569    // Regression test: authorization must be based on permissionScope (derived from
3570    // the type field), not on the tableName field. A user with only table-level ADMIN
3571    // should not be able to request global permissions by passing tableName with
3572    // permissionScope=GLOBAL.
3573    AccessTestAction tablePermWithGlobalScope = new AccessTestAction() {
3574      @Override
3575      public Object run() throws Exception {
3576        ACCESS_CONTROLLER.preGetUserPermissions(ObserverContextImpl.createAndPrepare(CP_ENV), null,
3577          null, TEST_TABLE, null, null, Permission.Scope.GLOBAL);
3578        return null;
3579      }
3580    };
3581
3582    // USER_ADMIN has global ADMIN, should be allowed
3583    verifyAllowed(tablePermWithGlobalScope, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN);
3584    // Users with only table-level ADMIN should be denied
3585    verifyDenied(tablePermWithGlobalScope, USER_OWNER, USER_ADMIN_CF, USER_CREATE, USER_RW, USER_RO,
3586      USER_NONE);
3587
3588    AccessTestAction tablePermWithNamespaceScope = new AccessTestAction() {
3589      @Override
3590      public Object run() throws Exception {
3591        ACCESS_CONTROLLER.preGetUserPermissions(ObserverContextImpl.createAndPrepare(CP_ENV), null,
3592          TEST_TABLE.getNamespaceAsString(), TEST_TABLE, null, null, Permission.Scope.NAMESPACE);
3593        return null;
3594      }
3595    };
3596
3597    // Users without namespace ADMIN should be denied
3598    verifyDenied(tablePermWithNamespaceScope, USER_OWNER, USER_ADMIN_CF, USER_CREATE, USER_RW,
3599      USER_RO, USER_NONE);
3600
3601    AccessTestAction tablePermWithTableScope = new AccessTestAction() {
3602      @Override
3603      public Object run() throws Exception {
3604        ACCESS_CONTROLLER.preGetUserPermissions(ObserverContextImpl.createAndPrepare(CP_ENV), null,
3605          null, TEST_TABLE, null, null, Permission.Scope.TABLE);
3606        return null;
3607      }
3608    };
3609
3610    // Users with table ADMIN should be allowed
3611    verifyAllowed(tablePermWithTableScope, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN, USER_OWNER);
3612    verifyDenied(tablePermWithTableScope, USER_ADMIN_CF, USER_CREATE, USER_RW, USER_RO, USER_NONE);
3613
3614    AccessTestAction globalPermWithNullScope = new AccessTestAction() {
3615      @Override
3616      public Object run() throws Exception {
3617        ACCESS_CONTROLLER.preGetUserPermissions(ObserverContextImpl.createAndPrepare(CP_ENV), null,
3618          null, null, null, null, null);
3619        return null;
3620      }
3621    };
3622
3623    // null scope falls back to old behavior (no tableName -> require global ADMIN)
3624    verifyAllowed(globalPermWithNullScope, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN);
3625    verifyDenied(globalPermWithNullScope, USER_OWNER, USER_ADMIN_CF, USER_CREATE, USER_RW, USER_RO,
3626      USER_NONE);
3627  }

3689        Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE, Permission.Action.CREATE,
3690        Permission.Action.ADMIN, Permission.Action.EXEC));
3691
3692      // Check for namespace access user

3695        Permission.Action.ADMIN, Permission.Action.CREATE));
3696      assertFalse(AccessControlClient.hasPermission(conn, TEST_TABLE.getNameAsString(),
3697        HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, user1.getShortName(),
3698        Permission.Action.ADMIN, Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.EXEC));
3699
3700      // Check for table owner

3702        HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, USER_OWNER.getShortName(),
3703        Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE, Permission.Action.EXEC,
3704        Permission.Action.CREATE, Permission.Action.ADMIN));
3705
3706      // Check for table user

3708        HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, USER_CREATE.getShortName(),
3709        Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE));
3710      assertFalse(AccessControlClient.hasPermission(conn, TEST_TABLE.getNameAsString(),
3711        HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, USER_RO.getShortName(),
3712        Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE));
3713
3714      // Check for family access user
3715      assertTrue(AccessControlClient.hasPermission(conn, TEST_TABLE.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY,
3716        HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, USER_RO.getShortName(), Permission.Action.READ));
3717      assertTrue(AccessControlClient.hasPermission(conn, TEST_TABLE.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY,
3718        HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, USER_RW.getShortName(), Permission.Action.READ,
3719        Permission.Action.WRITE));

3722        Permission.Action.ADMIN, Permission.Action.CREATE));

3726      assertFalse(AccessControlClient.hasPermission(conn, TEST_TABLE.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY,
3727        HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, USER_ADMIN_CF.getShortName(), Permission.Action.READ));
3728
3729      // Check for qualifier access user
3730      assertTrue(AccessControlClient.hasPermission(conn, TEST_TABLE.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY,
3731        TEST_QUALIFIER, user2.getShortName(), Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE));
3732      assertFalse(AccessControlClient.hasPermission(conn, TEST_TABLE.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY,
3733        TEST_QUALIFIER, user2.getShortName(), Permission.Action.EXEC, Permission.Action.READ));
3734      assertFalse(AccessControlClient.hasPermission(conn, TEST_TABLE.getNameAsString(),
3735        HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, TEST_QUALIFIER, USER_RW.getShortName(),
3736        Permission.Action.WRITE, Permission.Action.READ));

3747      try {

3750          HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, null, Permission.Action.READ));
3751        fail("this should have thrown IllegalArgumentException");
3752      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
3753        // expected
3754      }
3755
3756      revokeFromNamespaceUsingAccessControlClient(TEST_UTIL, conn, user1.getShortName(),
3757        NamespaceDescriptor.DEFAULT_NAMESPACE.getName(), Permission.Action.ADMIN,
3758        Permission.Action.CREATE, Permission.Action.READ);
3759      revokeFromTableUsingAccessControlClient(TEST_UTIL, conn, user2.getShortName(), TEST_TABLE,
3760        TEST_FAMILY, TEST_QUALIFIER, Permission.Action.READ, Permission.Action.WRITE);
3761    } finally {

3808  /*

3810   */
3811  private void validateGlobalUserACLForGetUserPermissions(final Connection conn, User nSUser1,
3812    User globalGroupUser1, User globalGroupUser2, Collection<String> superUsers, int superUserCount)
3813    throws Throwable {
3814    // Verify action privilege
3815    AccessTestAction globalUserPermissionAction = new AccessTestAction() {
3816      @Override
3817      public Object run() throws Exception {
3818        try (Connection conn = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf)) {
3819          conn.getAdmin().getUserPermissions(
3820            GetUserPermissionsRequest.newBuilder().withUserName("dummy").build());
3821        }
3822        return null;
3823      }
3824    };
3825    verifyAllowed(globalUserPermissionAction, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN, USER_GROUP_ADMIN);
3826    verifyDenied(globalUserPermissionAction, USER_GROUP_CREATE, USER_GROUP_READ, USER_GROUP_WRITE);
3827
3828    // Validate global user permission
3829    List<UserPermission> userPermissions;
3830    assertEquals(6 + superUserCount, AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, null).size());
3831    assertEquals(6 + superUserCount,
3832      AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, HConstants.EMPTY_STRING).size());
3833    assertEquals(6 + superUserCount,
3834      AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, null, HConstants.EMPTY_STRING).size());
3835    userPermissions = AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, null, USER_ADMIN.getName());
3836    verifyGetUserPermissionResult(userPermissions, 1, null, null, USER_ADMIN.getName(), superUsers);
3837    assertEquals(0, AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, null, nSUser1.getName()).size());
3838    // Global group user ACL
3839    assertEquals(1,
3840      AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, null, globalGroupUser1.getName()).size());
3841    assertEquals(2,
3842      AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, null, globalGroupUser2.getName()).size());
3843  }

3889  private void validateTableACLForGetUserPermissions(final Connection conn, User nSUser1,
3890    User tableGroupUser1, User tableGroupUser2, String nsPrefix, TableName table1, TableName table2,
3891    byte[] TEST_QUALIFIER2, Collection<String> superUsers) throws Throwable {
3892    AccessTestAction tableUserPermissionAction = new AccessTestAction() {
3893      @Override
3894      public Object run() throws Exception {
3895        try (Connection conn = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf)) {
3896          conn.getAdmin().getUserPermissions(GetUserPermissionsRequest.newBuilder(TEST_TABLE)
3897            .withFamily(TEST_FAMILY).withQualifier(TEST_QUALIFIER).withUserName("dummy").build());
3898        }
3899        return null;
3900      }
3901    };
3902    verifyAllowed(tableUserPermissionAction, SUPERUSER, USER_ADMIN, USER_OWNER, USER_ADMIN_CF);
3903    verifyDenied(tableUserPermissionAction, USER_CREATE, USER_RW, USER_RO, USER_NONE, USER_CREATE);
3904
3905    List<UserPermission> userPermissions;
3906    assertEquals(12, AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, nsPrefix + ".*").size());
3907    assertEquals(6, AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString()).size());
3908    assertEquals(6, AccessControlClient
3909      .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), HConstants.EMPTY_STRING).size());
3910    userPermissions = AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(),
3911      USER_ADMIN_CF.getName());
3912    verifyGetUserPermissionResult(userPermissions, 1, null, null, USER_ADMIN_CF.getName(), null);
3913    assertEquals(0, AccessControlClient
3914      .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), nSUser1.getName()).size());
3915    // Table group user ACL
3916    assertEquals(1, AccessControlClient
3917      .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), tableGroupUser1.getName()).size());
3918    assertEquals(1, AccessControlClient
3919      .getUserPermissions(conn, table2.getNameAsString(), tableGroupUser2.getName()).size());
3920
3921    // Table Users + CF
3922    assertEquals(12, AccessControlClient
3923      .getUserPermissions(conn, nsPrefix + ".*", HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY).size());
3924    userPermissions = AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, nsPrefix + ".*", TEST_FAMILY);
3925    verifyGetUserPermissionResult(userPermissions, 3, TEST_FAMILY, null, null, null);
3926    assertEquals(0, AccessControlClient
3927      .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), Bytes.toBytes("dummmyCF")).size());
3928
3929    // Table Users + CF + User
3930    assertEquals(3,
3931      AccessControlClient
3932        .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY, HConstants.EMPTY_STRING)
3933        .size());
3934    userPermissions = AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(),
3935      TEST_FAMILY, USER_ADMIN_CF.getName());
3936    verifyGetUserPermissionResult(userPermissions, 1, null, null, USER_ADMIN_CF.getName(),
3937      superUsers);
3938    assertEquals(0, AccessControlClient
3939      .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY, nSUser1.getName()).size());
3940
3941    // Table Users + CF + CQ
3942    assertEquals(3, AccessControlClient
3943      .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY, HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY)
3944      .size());
3945    assertEquals(1, AccessControlClient
3946      .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY, TEST_QUALIFIER).size());
3947    assertEquals(1, AccessControlClient
3948      .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY, TEST_QUALIFIER2).size());
3949    assertEquals(2, AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(),
3950      HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, USER_RW.getName()).size());
3951    assertEquals(0,
3952      AccessControlClient
3953        .getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(), TEST_FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("dummmyCQ"))
3954        .size());
3955
3956    // Table Users + CF + CQ + User
3957    assertEquals(3, AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(),
3958      TEST_FAMILY, HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, HConstants.EMPTY_STRING).size());
3959    assertEquals(1, AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(),
3960      TEST_FAMILY, TEST_QUALIFIER, USER_RW.getName()).size());
3961    assertEquals(1, AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(),
3962      TEST_FAMILY, TEST_QUALIFIER2, USER_RW.getName()).size());
3963    assertEquals(0, AccessControlClient.getUserPermissions(conn, table1.getNameAsString(),
3964      TEST_FAMILY, TEST_QUALIFIER2, nSUser1.getName()).size());
3965  }

3967  /*
3968   * Validate the user permission against the specified column family, column qualifier and user
3969   * name.
3970   */
3971  private void verifyGetUserPermissionResult(List<UserPermission> userPermissions, int resultCount,
3972    byte[] cf, byte[] cq, String userName, Collection<String> superUsers) {
3973    assertEquals(resultCount, userPermissions.size());
3974
3975    for (UserPermission perm : userPermissions) {
3976      if (perm.getPermission() instanceof TablePermission) {
3977        TablePermission tablePerm = (TablePermission) perm.getPermission();
3978        if (cf != null) {
3979          assertTrue(Bytes.equals(cf, tablePerm.getFamily()));
3980        }
3981        if (cq != null) {
3982          assertTrue(Bytes.equals(cq, tablePerm.getQualifier()));
3983        }
3984        if (userName != null && (superUsers == null || !superUsers.contains(perm.getUser()))) {
3985          assertTrue(userName.equals(perm.getUser()));
3986        }
3987      } else if (
3988        perm.getPermission() instanceof NamespacePermission
3989          || perm.getPermission() instanceof GlobalPermission
3990      ) {
3991        if (userName != null && (superUsers == null || !superUsers.contains(perm.getUser()))) {
3992          assertTrue(userName.equals(perm.getUser()));
3993        }
3994      }
3995    }
3996  }
